text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympics(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
Won(x, y, z) ::: x won y in z.
Country(x) ::: x is a country.
Medals(y) ::: y are medals.
Premises:
SportingEvent(summerOlympics) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympics(tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Country(unitedStates) ∧ Won(unitedStates, medals, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬In(lastSummerOlympics, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
